title: Check yourself: void bodies and the underscore

questions.stem: Per this page, which of these lambdas compiles when assigned to a `Consumer<String>`?

options.says: The page gives this very body as a compile error: an addition is not a statement expression, so it cannot be a void body.
A comparison is not a statement expression either, so by the page's rule it cannot be the body of a void lambda.
The page says a method call may be the body of a void lambda even when it returns a value; the value is discarded.

questions.stem: Per this page, what is the status in Java 21 of `_` as the name of an unused lambda parameter?

options.text: A standard feature, usable with no extra compiler flags
options.says: The page says it becomes standard only from Java 22 (JEP 456).

options.text: A preview feature, usable once --enable-preview is given
options.says: The page names JEP 443: a preview in Java 21 that needs --enable-preview.

options.text: A removed feature, which the compiler now turns down
options.says: The page describes it as a preview in Java 21 and standard from Java 22, not as removed.
